title: scene-server: SceneObject/set create into a region without access
description: Found during JMAP-38uq.6. SceneObject/set create checks that regionId names a stored region but never consults SceneBackend::may_access_region, so a user without access to an "invite" region can create objects in it (and a create learns that the region exists). draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00 §Region Access (L2362, L2367) only names SceneAvatar/set create (forbidden) and the /get methods (notFound); the draft is silent on SceneObject create. Decide: treat an inaccessible regionId like a missing one (enumeration-safe), or forbidden, or file a spec bead.
notes:
Mark 2026-10-20: Scene specs have known bugs; no further Scene crate work until the spec is fixed.
